Scope note · `domain:spec` seat 3 · `os-support-ai` · session `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP` · 2026-10-28T09:20Z

⛔ Not a claim. This card stays `pm:blocked` on #27155 (claim 6465227713). *(Edited: corrected after the #27155 dev's measurement.)*

The #27155 dev measured two more surfaces that carry the retired presentation. The seat ruled both out of #27155 and sends them here:
- **The page block `object-form`** (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, around L6847) declares its own `formType` with all six values, plus split / drawer / modal props. Its reader is the renderer this card edits.
- **The React `ObjectForm` block contract** (`react-blocks.ts` dataProps) reads `FormViewSchema`'s `splitDirection`, `drawerSide` and `drawerWidth`. Once `SplitForm` retires here, decide which of them still have a live reader on a surviving `formType`. A change that moves `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md` makes the PR governed (Tier H).

Narrowing either surface makes this PR a spec narrowing too: declare `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, use tombstones with prescriptions that match #27155's (live values only, since #26804 already retired `navigation.mode: 'split'`), and run the contract review a narrowing owes.

What #27155 lands, so this card does not repeat it: the `FormViewSchema.type` narrowing, `section.pane`, `splitSize`, `splitResizable`, and the showcase `task` view re-spelling. The drawer keys also sit on #27153.

Scope note 2 · `domain:spec` seat 3 · `os-support-ai` · session `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP` · 2026-10-28T11:47Z

⛔ Not a claim. Contract review 6468131018 on PR #27229 (#27155) measured three more carriers of the retired presentation. They belong here, with the `object-form` block's `formType` that the earlier scope note sends to this card:
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/block-config.ts` (~:188-196): the page-block inspector offers the block's `formType` values.
- `ui/content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` (~:898): it claims the block's `formType` aligns with `FormViewSchema.type`. That is false once #27229 lands.
- The `.describe()` strings of the kept `FormViewSchema` keys `modalSize`, `splitDirection` and `drawerSide` still say "(modal / split / drawer forms)". Once the React `ObjectForm` block's `formType` is settled here, re-word them to name the block's container modes rather than form-view types.

Unblocked · `domain:spec` seat 3 · `os-support-ai` · 2026-10-28T12:18Z

The blocker #27155 landed: PR #27229 merged at 2026-10-28T12:16Z, merge commit `14e9685fc9`, on `origin/main`. `FormViewSchema.type` now accepts only `simple` / `tabbed` / `wizard`, and `splitDirection`, `drawerSide` and `drawerWidth` stay in the spec for this card's renderer work. The two carriers the #27155 review found (`block-config.ts` ~:188-196, `ui/content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` ~:898) and scope notes 1 and 2 above still stand. `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue` here; the ui lane dispatches it. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Dispatch order · `domain:ui#2` · `session_01JQwxbXpF772qWJjojJvRXw` · 2026-10-28T12:37Z

You are the os-dev developer agent for exactly ONE card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#27159, in your own card thread. Your role definition is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` in the objectstack clone: read it IN FULL first and follow it as binding (it wins over this order on any conflict; name the conflict in your report). Read the repo-root `AGENTS.md` and `ui/AGENTS.md` before your first edit, and pm-dispatch `references/untrusted-text.md`. Read the card's full body and every comment yourself through REST (`curl -sS "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/27159" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`, every page); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`). ⛔ Never use a GitHub MCP tool, read or write.

Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; its `Branch:` line names your thread's branch. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names your thread's branch (`claude/project-thread-…`); if none does yet, send the seat thread "Take a third ui lane seat" (`cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8Uc2nCvWvLyYyaVYaUhakpJ`) one message with your branch name and wait. Read-only measuring is fine meanwhile. Worktree `objectstack-issue-27159` on that branch from a fresh `origin/main` (`git checkout --detach` the main checkout first, then `git worktree add --no-track -B <branch> ../objectstack-issue-27159 origin/main`); `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, F a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"]}]`, draft forced; `--dry-run` first); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=27159 --file=F --json` run ONCE with output captured to a file (no time-shaped stamp inside the fenced report JSON). ⛔ No other GitHub write except, for a CI red that is not yours, one PR comment and one `run_rerun_failed` through the relay. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, line 3 `Fixes #27159`, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran` (merge `origin/main` first if it refuses as STALE TREE); `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` is a gate on every ui card. Build the closure your tests import first (`bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c "pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '<pkg>^...' build"`). Changeset in the root `.changeset/` for each published package your diff changes (app-shell is `private: true`). ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green. If the premise fails, stop and report `premise_still_valid: false` with the evidence; ⛔ never force a fix.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Ruling 6464210455 on #27032 (batch #421 item 3, letter A′, maintainer 「其他同意」 2026-10-28) is the renderer half of the ADR-0050 cutover. The spec half #27155 landed as PR #27229 (`14e9685fc9`, 12:16Z): `FormViewSchema.type` is now `simple | tabbed | wizard`. `DrawerForm` and `ModalForm` stay as containers the caller supplies, and the #1890 layout forwarding stays. Scope notes 6465248799 and 6468180697 (spec seat 3) are part of this card; read both in full.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure; disproof welcome)

On `origin/main` `9c121400` (read-only check):
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx` imports `SplitForm` and `DrawerForm` (L41–42) and branches on `schema.formType === 'split'` (≈L535) and `=== 'drawer'` (≈L569), with a modal arm nearby. `SplitForm.tsx` is the only split module.
- Call sites pass a container `formType` into `ObjectForm`: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` ≈L1496/1513 (`'modal'`) and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useActionModal.tsx` ≈L280 (`'modal'`). `FormPage.tsx` ≈L811 forwards `form.type`, which is now never split, drawer or modal.
- The page block `object-form` still declares `formType: z.enum([...6 values])` at `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` ≈L6887, plus split, drawer and modal props. Its reader is this renderer. `react-blocks.ts` dataProps reads `splitDirection`, `drawerSide` and `drawerWidth`.
- Carriers named in scope note 2: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/block-config.ts` ≈L188–196 (the inspector offers the block's six values), `ui/content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` ≈L898 (claims alignment with `FormViewSchema.type`), and the `.describe()` strings of the kept `FormViewSchema` keys `modalSize`, `splitDirection` and `drawerSide`.

### PM suggested route (optional; measurement wins)

1. Remove the `split` branch, the `SplitForm` module, its tests and stories, and the `section.pane` readers left in plugin-form. Keep `DrawerForm` and `ModalForm` as containers. Switch the two `'modal'` call sites to the container-plus-layout spelling, so that no caller needs `ObjectForm` to choose a container.
2. The block `formType`: narrow the `object-form` block's enum to what still has a reader, with tombstones whose prescriptions match #27229's. Decide by measurement which of `splitDirection`, `drawerSide` and `drawerWidth` keep a live reader, and record it. #27153 (drawer keys implement-or-retire) is the open spec card for those keys, so say on #27153 what you found and do not close it from here unless the measurement settles it. Re-word the three `.describe()` strings, fix `block-config.ts` and the `schema-reference.md` line.
3. Tests: a `tabbed` layout inside `ModalForm` still renders (#1890 pin), and the AppContent / useActionModal modal still opens and saves. CONTROL: a block authored with a retired `formType` is refused with the prescription.

### Scope

File surface: `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/**`; `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useActionModal.tsx` and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/block-config.ts` at their call sites; `ui/content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`; `packages/spec/src/ui/{component.zod.ts,react-blocks.ts,view.zod.ts}` only for the block narrowing, its tombstones and the `.describe()` re-words; files that `pnpm gen:react-blocks` / the spec regen scripts regenerate; tests beside these. Root `.changeset/` for every published package touched.

Declarations if the block narrows: `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, and the contract review a narrowing owes. If `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md` regenerates, the PR is governed (Tier H): use the seat-1 route for `pr_create` (push a commit that undoes the Tier H path, run `pr_create`, revert it), so that no approver is asked before the director contract review PASS + seat ACCEPT (#26617).

Serial: open draft PR #27206 (spec seat, #25923, Tier H) edits `component.zod.ts`, `react-blocks.ts`, `view.zod.ts` and `react-blocks.md`. Keep your spec hunks to the `object-form` block and the three describes. If #27206 lands first, merge `origin/main` and regenerate (no hand-merge of generated files). No other open PR touches these files (open PR list read 2026-10-28T12:37Z).

### Tier

Read `dispatch-gates --tier` on your diff and record it. Expected: `TIER_DEFAULT` for a ui-only diff; governed (Tier H) if `skills/**` regenerates. Effort `high` (M–L). `Clause-②` and `Metadata-protocol` are as declared above.
